tui_config_problems_action_key_duplicate: Problem in atlas.yaml: two actions use the same key. {key} is the key and {action} the label of the first action.
tui_config_problems_action_key_open_key: Problem in atlas.yaml: an action uses the open_key of a service. {key} is the key and {service} the service.
tui_config_problems_affected_bad_glob: Problem in atlas.yaml: a glob of an affected rule does not parse. {glob} is the glob and {reason} the glob parser's own message (English).
tui_config_problems_affected_command_bla: Problem in atlas.yaml: affected.command is empty.
tui_config_problems_affected_rule_no_mat: Problem in atlas.yaml: an affected rule has an empty match list.
tui_config_problems_affected_task_unknow: Problem in atlas.yaml: an affected rule names a task that is no action label. {task} is the text written there.
tui_config_problems_condition_completed: Problem in atlas.yaml: depends_on uses the `completed_successfully` condition on a service with no command. {dependency} is that service; the condition name is a config value and stays as is. i18n-allow glossary:service
tui_config_problems_condition_log_ready: Problem in atlas.yaml: depends_on uses the `log_ready` condition on a service that has no ready_log. {dependency} is that service; `log_ready` is a config value and stays as is. i18n-allow glossary:service
tui_config_problems_dependency_cycle: Problem in atlas.yaml: services depend on each other in a loop. {cycle} is the closed path of service names, such as a -> b -> a.
tui_config_problems_dependency_self: Problem in atlas.yaml: a service lists itself in depends_on.
tui_config_problems_deploy_app_pattern: Problem in atlas.yaml: deploy.app is empty or has characters outside a-z, 0-9 and a hyphen. The pattern is a regular expression and stays as is.
tui_config_problems_deploy_compose_file_: Problem in atlas.yaml: a deploy service sets compose_file but is not of kind compose.
tui_config_problems_deploy_keep_min: Problem in atlas.yaml: a deploy target keeps fewer than 2 releases.
tui_config_problems_deploy_link_key: Problem in atlas.yaml: a deploy link key is empty, absolute or climbs out of the release.
tui_config_problems_deploy_link_value: Problem in atlas.yaml: a deploy link value does not start with a slash.
tui_config_problems_deploy_path_absolute: Problem in atlas.yaml: a deploy target's dir or pause_marker does not start with a slash.
tui_config_problems_deploy_restart_only_: Problem in atlas.yaml: a deploy service sets restart but is not of kind command.
tui_config_problems_deploy_restart_requi: Problem in atlas.yaml: a deploy service of kind command has no restart. `kind`, `command` and `restart` are config keys and stay as is.
tui_config_problems_deploy_service_dupli: Problem in atlas.yaml: a deploy target lists the same service twice. {name} is the service name.
tui_config_problems_deploy_services_empt: Problem in atlas.yaml: a deploy target has no services.
tui_config_problems_deploy_targets_empty: Problem in atlas.yaml: deploy.targets is empty.
tui_config_problems_header: First line of the list of problems found in atlas.yaml (atlas config check, atlas dev, the desktop project list). {count} is how many problems follow; a colon ends it.
tui_config_problems_key_builtin: Problem in atlas.yaml: an action key or a service open_key is already bound by the dashboard. {key} is that single key.
tui_config_problems_memory_warn_above_ma: Problem in atlas.yaml: memory_warn is not below max_memory. {max_memory} is the max_memory text.
tui_config_problems_not_saved: Error of the desktop Config tab when Save is refused because the text has problems. {count} is how many, {path} the key path of the first one and {message} its sentence.
tui_config_problems_open_tunnel_without_: Problem in atlas.yaml: an action asks to open the tunnel and the file has no tunnel block. {action} is the action label.
tui_config_problems_port_duplicate: Problem in atlas.yaml: two enabled services use the same port. {port} is the number and {other} the service that has it first.
tui_config_problems_ready_exclusive: Problem in atlas.yaml: a ready probe sets both or neither of `http` and `command`.
tui_config_problems_ready_log_regex: Problem in atlas.yaml: ready_log is not a valid regular expression. {detail} is the regex engine's own message (English, a fragment of its error). Same English as the validator's message, which a program reads.
tui_config_problems_remote_command: Problem in atlas.yaml: a service with `remote:` also sets `command`.
tui_config_problems_remote_host_invalid: Problem in atlas.yaml: `remote.host` is not a plain host name. {host} is the text written there.
tui_config_problems_remote_port_missing: Problem in atlas.yaml: a service with `remote:` has no local `port` to forward to.
tui_config_problems_remote_ssh_invalid: Problem in atlas.yaml: `remote.ssh` is not a plain host alias or user@host. {ssh} is the text written there.
tui_config_problems_size_invalid: Problem in atlas.yaml: max_memory or memory_warn is not a size. {value} is the text written there.
tui_config_problems_unknown_key: Problem in atlas.yaml: a key the schema does not have, with no close match. The key path comes before the sentence.
tui_config_problems_unknown_key_suggest: Problem in atlas.yaml: a key the schema does not have, with the closest known key as {suggestion}.
tui_config_problems_unknown_service: Problem in atlas.yaml: a depends_on entry or a profile member names a service that does not exist, with no close match. {name} is the name written there.
tui_config_problems_unknown_service_sugg: Problem in atlas.yaml: like tui_config_problems_unknown_service, with the closest service as {suggestion}.
tui_config_problems_warn_autostart_false: Warning of atlas config check: a service depends on one that does not start by itself. {service} is the dependent and {dependency} the one started by hand. i18n-allow glossary:service
tui_config_problems_warn_healthy_no_prob: Warning of atlas config check: a healthy condition on a service that has nothing to probe. {dependency} is that service; healthy, port, health and ready_log are config words and stay as is.
tui_config_problems_worktree_setup_unkno: Problem in atlas.yaml: worktree.setup has an {{action: ...}} reference to an action that does not exist. {action} is the text written there.
